name: The Kidnapper
source:
The mysterious culprit behind Maite and Tadeo's entrapment. Communicating through the kidnapped pair solely through the use of speakers, their appearance and identity are unknown.

"Don't be afraid... Think of this as your new home."

[From [url=https://florisam.itch.io/our-dollhouse]itch.io[/url]]
